Whether you are running a custom air intake | a fabricated intake manifold | or a C&C truck where the factory harness falls short | this extension gets the job done cleanly and reliably.




Built with the same quality standards as the full Baldwin's harness lineup — designed to handle the under-hood heat | vibration | and environmental exposure of a working diesel truck without compromise.

The ECUMaster 8-Channel EGT Module is a high-performance exhaust gas temperature monitoring system designed for advanced engine management and motorsport applications.
This module allows you to monitor up to eight individual EGT probes and transmit the data directly over CAN bus | enabling seamless integration with ECUs | digital dashes | and data logging systems.
For high-performance engines — especially boosted applications — EGT monitoring isn’t optional. It’s protection.
Precision data. Maximum awareness.

🔥 Key Features
• Supports up to 8 individual EGT inputs• CAN bus communication• Designed for seamless integration with ECUMaster systems• High-speed digital data transmission• Compact motorsport-ready design• Ideal for data logging and safety strategies

📊 Why Monitor EGT?
Exhaust gas temperature is critical for 
• Detecting lean conditions• Monitoring cylinder balance• Protecting turbochargers• Preventing piston damage• Advanced tuning strategies
Individual cylinder monitoring allows for more precise tuning and safer high-performance operation.
If you're pushing power | you should be watching heat.

🛠️ Ideal Applications
• Standalone ECU builds• Turbocharged engines• Diesel performance applications• High-boost race setups• Data-driven tuning environments
This module is built for engines where thermal management matters.

🔧 CAN Integration
The 8-Channel EGT Module transmits temperature data digitally via CAN | allowing 
• Clean wiring integration• Reliable data transmission• Real-time logging• ECU-based safety strategies• Dash display visualization
Digital communication eliminates analog signal noise and improves reliability.

⚙️ Installation Notes
Professional installation is recommended.
Proper probe placement and calibration are essential for accurate readings and safe engine operation.
Always confirm compatibility with your ECU and CAN configuration prior to purchase.

🚀 Why This Matters
Excessive EGT can end a build quickly.
With eight channels of real-time temperature data | you gain visibility into combustion conditions and cylinder balance — allowing smarter tuning decisions and safer operation under load.
When power increases | monitoring becomes mandatory.
